name: Intercom Inbox
verified_note: Template. Intercom ships frequent UI changes; verify before trusting any locator.
quirks: Notes and replies share one composer; confirm the mode before typing.
Fin or another AI may already have replied — read the whole thread first.
Assignment matters: do not reply in a teammate's conversation without a handoff note.
Composer accepts Enter-to-send per workspace setting; verify before relying on it.
auth: Browse MCP reuses the logged-in browser session.

verify: count matches per selector; fix this file; set verified
read_thread: open the row matching the contact
snapshot the conversation; capture all parts, internal notes (do not treat notes as customer messages), assignee, tags
read the Intercom conversation id from the URL
send_reply: click composer, browse.type the reply, browse.press Enter or click Send (workspace setting decides)
verify the part appears with an outbound marker
note: switch composer to Note mode before typing an internal note
never put internal reasoning in Reply mode

guardrails: Intercom notes and replies share a composer; confirm mode before typing.
If the conversation is owned by another teammate, do not reply without assignment or an explicit handoff note.
Fin/AI answers may already have replied — read the full thread before adding a human reply.
